messages:
elaine_sales: Quick sync: Zenith Health wants a single-day POC to validate 24h throughput/latency and cost. Baseline 150 rps steady, bursts to 900 rps for 3m every 20m. They also asked which security items we can guarantee for a trial (SAML + private endpoint). Can we confirm run plan, rough token cost, and minimal security checklist ASAP?
josh_perf: Proposed plan: warmup 20m (cache fill, 40% qps), steady 3h @150rps, burst window (repeat: 3m@900rps every 20m for ~6 hours total), long-soak 12h @100rps, then quick recovery test. Capture p50/p95/p99, batch-size hist, queue depth, gpu util.
ravi_infra: Provision notes: allocate two pools: pool-steady sized for 150rps, pool-burst autoscale to handle 900rps short bursts. I'll reserve 5 x a100-sim nodes for the window. Canary route to smaller model ready for automated fallback.
josh_perf: Runner sample: ```rbench --model redwood-13b-q4 --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --qps 150 --concurrency 60 --duration 10800 --burst-pattern "900@3m:every20m" --warmup 1200``` Suggest batching.max_tokens=72 and max_wait_ms=10 steady; increase to 25ms in bursts.
maya_sec: Security minimal checklist we can share: IdP metadata XML, test admin users, preferred region, corporate IPs for peering. We can enable a privatelink endpoint for the POC and KMS-managed keys; full HSM requires extra procurement. SOC2 report available.
kevin_ae: Cost please: token estimate for 24h plus delta if they sign reserved baseline. Need slide copy for procurement.
josh_perf: Quick token calc: avg 35 tokens/request. Tokens/hr at 150rps = 18,900,000. For 24h baseline+soak approx 480M tokens. At $0.0008/1k => ~$384. Add ~15% for burst compute overhead => ~$441. Reserved baseline pricing will cut unit cost ~25% for committed monthly. I'll drop a small table.
ravi_infra: Ops-bot: provisioning request queued. ETA for sandbox ready 2027-06-01 08:00 PT.
elaine_sales: Great — Maya, paste the short checklist here so I can include in email. Josh/Ravi please post the run artifacts after smoke. We'll propose 99% uptime for the POC window.
maya_sec: Paste snip: "SAML 2.0 (IdP metadata + ACS), Privatelink or VPC peering (provide corporate IPs), KMS-managed keys for logs/tenant data. SOC2/ISO27001 available. HSM: additional onboarding required"
josh_perf: I'll run a 15m smoke now and post p95/p99. If p99 > 500ms during bursts, we'll bump batch cap and increase warmup.
elaine_sales: Thanks team. I'll prepare the customer email once we have smoke results and the cost slide.
